title: Member Visit Credit Allotments by Linden Membership Tier
content:
Every tier of Linden Memberships grants member visit credits at the start of each calendar month of membership. The allotment, whether unused credits roll into the next month, and the largest number that may roll over are fixed per tier.

## Allotments

| Tier | Credits granted each month | Unused credits roll over | Most credits that may roll over |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | 2 | No | 0 |
| Linden Essential Membership | 4 | No | 0 |
| Linden Family Membership | 10 | No | 0 |
| Linden Plus Membership | 6 | Yes | 2 |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 8 | Yes | 4 |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 12 | Yes | 6 |

## Distinguishing the tiers

- On the Linden Connect Virtual Membership, Linden Essential Membership and Linden Family Membership, credits do not roll over; the rollover figure of 0 reflects that.
- On the Linden Plus Membership, Linden Premier Concierge Membership and Linden Executive Health Membership, unused credits roll over up to the figure in the last column.
- The Linden Family Membership allotment of 10 credits is one monthly allotment for the membership.

## Hypothetical month-end illustrations

| Tier | Unused credits at month end (hypothetical) | Most that may roll over | Credits rolling over |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Plus Membership | 5 | 2 | 2 |
| Linden Plus Membership | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | 9 | 6 | 6 |
| Linden Essential Membership | 3 | 0 (no rollover) | 0 |
